policy: Equipment-only editorial analogies tied to a named event and source. Preserve participants, dates, coordinates, opposing camps, strength and loss evidence. A profile identifies a representative documented component, not an order of battle; anonymous event profiles never propagate to identified participants. Explicit land medium marks reviewed shore forces. Unassigned equipment stays unknown. An explicit reviewed kind may recognize a source-identified polity or military unit; it never converts a person or an ambiguous modern administrative entity into an army.
